Set a layer's renderer

Source: R/arc-map.R
add_renderer.Rd

Attaches a renderer to a layer built by as_feature_layer(), so that a symbology this package does not expose can still be handed to add_layer().

Usage

add_renderer(layer, renderer)

Arguments

layer

Defines which IFeatureLayer to modify.

renderer

Defines the renderer, an ISimpleRenderer or an IUniqueValueRenderer.

Value

layer, with the renderer set on its layerDefinition.

Examples

df <- data.frame(species = c("a", "b"), mass = c(1, 5))

as_feature_layer(df) |>
  add_renderer(ISimpleRenderer(symbol = ISimpleMarkerSymbol(size = 8)))
